title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Benefits
description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff - payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR - so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

 
All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) - because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .

 
AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Benefits Advisory team, you will be directly accountable for key architectural improvements to Gusto's benefits platform. This is a full-stack role where you will design and build platform capabilities that enable customers to explore, apply for, and maintain their benefits within your product area.

Your work will focus on transforming our benefits opportunity, shopping and renewal flows , creating clear system boundaries that enable efficient reuse and increased scalability, allowing the ability to offer a wider variety of products more quickly. You will design services that continue to scale the organization, with an emphasis on enabling novel AI-driven interfaces to deliver a delightful benefits shopping experience. 

You’ll operate at the intersection of marketing, sales, operations and engineering.  If you are passionate about building highly scalable systems that can reason, predict, and personalize to unlock Gusto Benefits’ next phase of sustainable growth, we’d love to have you join our team.

About the Team

The Benefits Advisory team is building the next generation of infrastructure that powers benefits applications, making it easier than ever to give customers access to the absolute best benefits for their needs.

Our mission is to build a robust system that informs our customers of the most relevant benefits options, making it easier than ever to confidently fulfill benefits that fit our customers current and future needs. We’re building a world-class technology platform designed to understand customer context in real-time, and continuously improve through data and feedback. This means rapid experimentation, fast learning, and strong cross-functional partnership.

We prioritize quality, observability, and uptime because these intelligent systems are fundamental to Gusto's growth and brand. We partner closely with Marketing, Sales, and Operations to build and connect the AI-powered tools they use every day.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

• Architect and evolve our customer-facing web platforms with a focus on scale and performance

Build innovative AI interfaces to best assist our customers

• Design, build, and maintain shared services to enable rapid iteration on product offerings

• Implement and optimize key workflows for a best-in-class customer experience.

• Write high-quality, well-tested code across the stack, leveraging AI-powered tools to accelerate  development and improve reliability

• Support, mentor, and up-level fellow engineers on the team, helping to establish best practices for AI-native design patterns.

• Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales, Operations and leadership to translate business needs into technical solutions that fit our needs now and in the future.

• Influence the technical roadmap for your area of the Benefits Advisory platform, ensuring your work aligns with Gusto's AI-native strategy and team goals

title: Staff Manufacturing Engineer, Propulsion
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril's Air Dominance & Strike (AD&S) Manufacturing Engineering team is seeking a Propulsion Manufacturing Engineer to provide subject matter expertise on propulsion system manufacturing across our portfolio of autonomous aircraft, cruise missiles, and loitering munitions. This position may be filled at either the Senior or Staff level depending on experience and qualifications. This role covers the full spectrum of propulsion technologies relevant to AD&S - air-breathing jet turbines, ramjets, and solid rocket motors - and is responsible for ensuring that propulsion hardware can be manufactured, assembled, tested, and integrated at production rate with the quality and reliability our programs demand.
You will bring deep expertise in the manufacturing processes, materials, and quality requirements specific to propulsion systems. Your knowledge of how these systems are built - from turbine blade casting and combustor fabrication to solid propellant processing and nozzle manufacturing - is what makes you valuable. You are the person who knows what can go wrong in propulsion production and how to prevent it through design influence, process control, and supplier qualification.
A critical part of this role is working directly with design engineers and program-level manufacturing engineers to evaluate propulsion designs for producibility, drive DFM improvements, and support the selection and qualification of propulsion suppliers and contract manufacturers. You will also support propulsion system test campaigns from a manufacturing engineering perspective, including integration, acceptance testing, and anomaly resolution. This is an inherently cross-functional role: you will work daily with supply chain, quality, operations, test engineering, and program teams.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Serve as a propulsion manufacturing engineering subject matter expert across AD&S programs, covering air-breathing turbines, ramjets, and solid rocket motors.

• Evaluate propulsion system designs for manufacturability, assembly, and cost - leading or supporting DFM/DFA reviews and driving design changes that improve producibility without compromising performance.

• Work directly with design engineers and program manufacturing engineers to translate propulsion manufacturing constraints into actionable design feedback.

• Assist in the selection and qualification of propulsion suppliers and contract manufacturers - assessing manufacturing capability, process maturity, quality systems, and cost competitiveness for propulsion-specific production.

• Conduct or participate in supplier manufacturing assessments for propulsion hardware, including facility reviews, process audits, special process qualification (casting, brazing, propellant processing, thermal spray), and production readiness evaluations.

• Develop and maintain manufacturing process requirements and standards for propulsion-specific processes including turbine component manufacturing, combustor and hot section fabrication, solid propellant mixing and casting, nozzle manufacturing, and propulsion system assembly and integration.

title: Service-Oriented Architect
description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Service-Oriented Architect
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)

Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking a seasoned Microservices Architect to lead the design and evolution of large-scale microservices ecosystems built on modern container platforms and cloud-native technology stacks. The role requires deep expertise in service decomposition, domain-driven design, distributed data management, and runtime concerns such as resilience, observability, and security at scale. The ideal candidate brings hands-on architectural leadership across complex transformations, with a clear point of view on when microservices are the right answer, how to evolve them safely, and how to keep the resulting estate maintainable over the long term.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.

• Eight or more years of software engineering experience, with several years in architecture roles.

• Deep expertise in microservices design, domain-driven design, and distributed systems patterns.

• Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, and service mesh technologies.

• Proficiency in at least one major backend language such as Java, Go, or C#.

• Strong understanding of API design, event-driven architectures, and asynchronous messaging.

• Experience operating high-traffic, latency-sensitive systems in production.

• Strong knowledge of cloud platforms and managed services across at least one major provider.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Demonstrated ability to lead architecture initiatives spanning multiple teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with platform engineering and internal developer platform construction.

• Familiarity with Istio, Linkerd, Envoy, or comparable service mesh technologies.

• Exposure to FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization at scale.

• Public speaking, open-source contributions, or published technical writing.

• Experience in regulated industries with strict compliance requirements.

title: 2027 Summer Intern, MS/PhD, Software Engineer, Simulation Evaluation ML Model
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Software Engineering builds the brains of Waymo's fully autonomous driving technology. Our software allows the Waymo Driver to perceive the world around it, make the right decision for every situation, and deliver people safely to their destinations. We think deeply and solve complex technical challenges in areas like robotics, perception, decision-making and deep learning, while collaborating with hardware and systems engineers. If you’re a software engineer or researcher who’s curious and passionate about Level 4 autonomous driving, we'd like to meet you. 

Waymo interns partner with leaders in the industry on projects that create impact to the company. We believe learning is a two-way street: applying your knowledge while providing you with opportunities to expand your skill-set. Interns are an important part of our culture and our recruiting pipeline. Join us at Waymo for a fun and rewarding internship!

 

You will:

• Design and implement an automated semantic extraction pipeline that parses large-scale simulation logs, vehicle trajectory data, and multi-agent behavioral events into structured graph representations (entities, temporal relationships, and causal interactions)

• Develop temporal graph modeling techniques to capture time-varying multi-agent interactions, road context, and safety-critical driving events

• Build a multi-modal hybrid retrieval engine (combining dense vector embeddings, keyword search, and graph traversal) to enable fast scenario discovery and serve as structured memory for automated failure analysis agents

• Create interactive data exploration tools and visualization dashboards (e.g., Jupyter/Colab-based explorers) to help autonomy engineers and researchers analyze complex scenario distribution

• Benchmark retrieval precision, recall, and query latency against traditional tabular and relational search baselines

• Collaborate cross-functionally with simulation researchers, machine learning engineers, and software infrastructure teams to document system architecture and establish roadmap recommendations

 

You have:

• Currently enrolled in a graduate program (PhD or Master’s) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative field, with at least one academic term remaining

• Strong software development experience in Python and/or C++ in a Linux development environment

• Solid foundation in core computer science concepts, data structures, algorithm complexity, and distributed data systems

• Hands-on experience with modern deep learning frameworks (such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow)

title: Security Specialist Solutions Architect

We're looking for a Security Specialist to own those conversations - a specialist overlay within our AMER Solutions Architecture team, brought in when security, data residency, or regulatory compliance conversations come up on a deal.

What You'll Be Doing

title: Mental Health Therapist - Tennessee

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. At NOCD , we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD , we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

• Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 676,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Financial Crimes Compliance team builds and oversees Airwallex’s global financial crime framework across AML/CTF, sanctions, risk assessment, FCC operations, monitoring and testing, and investigations. The team works closely with Product, Operations, Risk, Regulatory Legal & Compliance, and regional MLROs to make sure our controls are well designed, practical, and effective as Airwallex scales globally.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As Senior Manager, FCC Program Management, you’ll lead a multi-year effort to strengthen Airwallex’s global financial crime framework as we scale across products and regions. This is a new role with broad scope: you’ll shape the target operating model, improve processes and systems, and bring stronger discipline to FCC-wide change. You’ll be the central connector across senior leaders and cross-functional teams, making sure work is practical, well sequenced, and built to stick in BAU.

 

This role is hybrid. Based in London.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Lead a global, multi-year FCC transformation across operating model, process, systems, testing, and controls.

- Build and drive the roadmap, with clear sequencing across priorities, dependencies, and risks.

- Use AI, automation, and data tools to improve FCC program tracking, reporting, and delivery across complex global workstreams.

- Run disciplined governance across working groups, SteerCos, RAID, and executive updates.

- Work hands-on with FCC and cross-functional leaders to turn complexity into clear plans, decisions, and action.

- Define success measures, evidence progress, and lead smooth transition into BAU.

 

WHO YOU ARE

We’re looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

 

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

- 10 years leading large, multi-workstream transformation programs in financial services or fintech.

- Direct experience in financial crime program change across areas such as AML/CTF, sanctions, FCC operations, and monitoring and testing.

- Practical experience using AI, automation, and modern tools to improve program planning, reporting, and execution in complex environments.

- A track record of delivering multiple global or multi-region programs at more than one complex institution.

- Highly organized, hands-on, and strong at turning complexity into action.

- Strong executive presence, clear communication skills, and project management certification such as PMP or PRINCE2.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- Experience in fintech, payments, or digital banking, ideally in fast-moving, global environments.

- Background in consulting, regulatory remediation, or large-scale risk and compliance change.

- Strong proficiency with program tools, dashboards, and executive reporting.

We're running a paid study on data structuring practices within architecture firms. Transforming messy operational data into clean evaluations and structured formats is critical for post-training workflows. Help us evaluate the current methodologies and challenges teams face when organizing this specialized architectural data.
How It Works
You will participate in a remote video interview to discuss how your firm handles operational data. We will ask you to walk us through the end-to-end process of turning unstructured architectural data into usable evaluations. You will be shown a few hypothetical data transformation scenarios and asked to provide feedback on potential workflow improvements. We will also ask you to describe the specific tools and practices your team relies on for post-training data management.
Who This Is For
We are looking for operations specialists, data managers, and technical architects who handle operational data within architecture firms. We welcome data operations leads, BIM managers, and internal workflow specialists with direct experience in post-training evaluations. If you regularly wrangle messy firm data into structured formats, this study is a great fit.
What You'll Do

• Discuss how your architecture firm transforms messy operational data into structured evaluations.

• Walk us through your day-to-day data management and post-training workflows.

• Evaluate hypothetical data structuring scenarios and provide feedback on their efficiency.

• Describe the tools and methodologies your team uses to manage internal architectural data.

Who Should Apply

• Professional experience handling data operations or workflows within an architecture firm.

• Hands-on experience converting unstructured operational data into structured formats.

title: Freelance - Learning Content Reviewer French
description:
FREELANCE LEARNING CONTENT REVIEWER: FRENCH (ALL GENDERS)

ABOUT BABBEL LABS

Babbel Labs is building the future of language learning. We're an AI-first, independent company within the Babbel group, based in Berlin. Our teams bring AI, R&D and product together to ship experiences that set a new standard for how people learn.

ABOUT THE ROLE AT BABBEL LABS

We're a small, fast-moving team rethinking how people learn languages with AI. We're looking for a detail-oriented freelance Learning Content Reviewer to make sure our French content is accurate, natural and genuinely useful, so learners pick up French the way it's really spoken and written. This is a freelance role, paid hourly.

Speed, precision and quality are how we work. You'll review content as it's created, including content produced with the help of AI, and help us catch what machines miss. Your feedback will directly shape what learners experience and how our curriculum grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Review learning content across formats. Check text, audio and images for accuracy, clarity, naturalness and consistency, and flag anything that could confuse or mislead a learner.

- Review and shape the curriculum. Assess how lessons build on each other, spot gaps or overlaps, and suggest improvements to structure, progression and learning goals.

- Ensure French content is authentic and current. Check grammar, spelling, register (tu vs. vous), idioms and cultural references, and make sure audio reflects natural French pronunciation.

- Quality-check AI-generated content. Evaluate content created with AI tools, identify recurring errors and help us improve how that content is produced.

- Give clear, actionable feedback. Document issues and suggestions in a way that content creators, linguists and engineers can act on quickly.

- Help raise the quality bar. Contribute to review guidelines, style standards and checklists that keep content consistent at scale.

- Work across disciplines with product managers, linguists, learning content strategists and engineers.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- Relevant experience. 2+ years of experience in at least one of the following: proofreading, translation, language teaching, or learning content quality testing.

- Language skills. Native or near-native French, plus fluent English. Excellent oral and written communication skills in both.

- A sharp eye for detail. You notice the small things, from a mistranslated word to an audio clip that doesn't match its transcript.

- A learner-first mindset. You understand what makes content clear and motivating for someone learning a new language.

- Comfort with AI tools. You're curious about how AI is changing content creation and happy to use it as part of your workflow.

- Reliability and independence. You manage your own time, meet deadlines and communicate proactively when something needs attention.

- Comfort with ambiguity. You're happy working in a fast-changing environment where processes evolve as we learn.

WHAT YOU'LL GET

- A consumer product used around the world. Your reviews directly improve a live product that real learners use every day, globally.

- Meaningful impact. Your feedback shapes the content and curriculum, not just the final polish.

- Competitive hourly rate. Pay that reflects your experience and the quality of your work.

We are a learning company, inside and out, and we encourage you to apply even if you do not fit all the technical requirements - all candidates are assessed based on skills, qualifications and on our business needs. Rho is the modern banking platform built for the AI era. Startups and growth-stage companies can open accounts in minutes, issue cards, manage expenses, pay bills, and close the books - all in one connected platform backed by real human support.

About the Role

We're looking for a Video Producer to help scale Rho's in-house creative studio. This is a hands-on role for someone who can make performance-driven content founders actually watch, share, and remember. You'll report to our Video Storyteller and work across every stage of production: shooting, editing, packaging, and publishing across X, YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok, and Instagram.

- Edit at volume and at quality. Cut long-form episodes, short-form clips, product videos, and brand pieces, from rough cut through final delivery.

- Turn one piece of long-form content into platform-native cuts for X, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn, each with its own hook, pacing, and packaging.

- Shoot and run production. Operate cameras, lighting, and audio on interviews, studio shoots, events, and run-and-gun content.

- Track and iterate. Monitor views, retention, and engagement, and use what you learn to sharpen edits and formats.

Qualifications

- 2+ years of experience in video editing, content production, or social content, whether in-house, agency-side, or as an independent creator.

- Fluency in video editing (Final Cut or Premiere Pro) - creating quality visual treatments, sound design, and pacing.

Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

Wolt's Shared Service Center in Budapest is home to a team of 40 people who keep our operations running across markets. Ten of them focus on one mission: getting German merchants to live on Wolt quickly and correctly. They own the onboarding journey from the moment a partner signs to the day they start receiving orders. Now we're looking for someone to lead them.

As Onboarding Team Lead, you'll be based in Budapest and work closely with our Onboarding Operations team in Germany, reporting to the Global Head of Business Process Outsourcing Management. You'll lead a team of 12 FTE, own the German onboarding pipeline, and make sure every partner gets a smooth, high-quality start on Wolt. The team is experienced and established, and it's ready for a leader who can raise the bar on speed, quality and process, while being its biggest advocate.

What you’ll be doing

You'll be responsible for how quickly and how well German merchants are onboarded onto Wolt. That means leading the people, owning the pipeline, and keeping a close eye on the numbers. You'll also be the go-to person when things get stuck.

• Lead, coach and develop a team of 12 FTE onboarding specialists, support them daily, and spot knowledge gaps and training needs.

• Own the onboarding pipeline so it always reflects reality. New venues are assigned the same day, follow-ups and on-hold reasons stay up to date, and stalled cases get escalated or offboarded instead of left open.

• Track the team's key onboarding KPIs, such as time to onboard and new live venues, so you always know where the team stands and can flag deviations early.

• Work with Sales, Account Management, Product and the Onboarding Operations team in Germany to escalate blockers early and improve how we onboard.

• Plan team capacity ahead of holidays, business trips and short weeks so no partner is ever left without an owner.

Our humble expectations

• You have at least 2 years of experience leading a team of 8 or more people, including setting clear performance expectations and following up on them.

• You have 3+ years of experience in operations in a fast-paced environment such as a marketplace, e-commerce or a shared service center.

• You're fluent in both German and English, written and spoken, because you'll work daily with German partners and stakeholders.

• You're comfortable working with data and use KPIs and dashboards to understand performance and make decisions.

• You're structured and detail-oriented, and you keep pipelines, timelines and data accurate without being chased.

• You take ownership, spot opportunities to improve processes, and drive changes independently.

What we offer

• A key leadership role shaping how merchants in one of Wolt's biggest markets join the platform.

• A team that's already up and running, so you can focus on raising the bar rather than starting from scratch.

• Strong knowledge of backup/restore strategies, index maintenance, performance tuning, and HA/DR solutions like Availability Groups, log shipping, or mirroring.

• Comfortable supporting customer-managed on-premise servers, VPN/ExpressRoute-integrated cloud VMs, and internal lab environments.

Lead the domain engine. Understand each client’s business deeply and align solutions to achieve their objectives.

•
Lead the presales function. Own the full presales lifecycle and partner closely with Sales to drive technical wins on strategic and enterprise opportunities.

•
Manage and develop the team. Hire, coach, and grow a team of Solution Architects and Business Analysts. Set standards, build expertise, balance workloads across active deals, and foster a culture of technical rigor.

•
Drive scoping and discovery. Personally lead scoping and discovery for strategic prospects, uncovering requirements, identifying risks, and defining solutions that map to real business outcomes.

•
Own the RFP process. Run the RFP response process end to end, ensuring responses are accurate, differentiated, and delivered on time.

•

•

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 95 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

AT ALMEDIA, YOU’LL:

- Own way more, way earlier - you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

- Push harder, get further - this isn’t a 9-5. We highly reward intensity.

- Join a rare environment - you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

- Fully present - we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

GROWTH MANAGER (BERLIN)

Salary Range: €55K - €75k

AT A GLANCE

You'll own a real book of business in the Turkish market. There is a sales and account-management motion. The size of the responsibility comes from top-line ownership. Quota chasing is not the job. You shape the work and execute it.

WHAT YOU’LL DO 🎯

- Own a book of 5-15 advertiser accounts end-to-end. You'll be the person behind the growth and expansion efforts in the Turkish market. The one advertisers ask when something breaks. The one our Director checks in with when an account spikes.

- Grow the revenue line. You are measured on the top-line you grow, not on activity. You communicate clearly, you drive yourself without being managed, and you stay open-minded when the data proves you wrong.

- Run the ROAS dial. With guidance from senior team members, tune Almedia's internal ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) targets per offer, geo, and OS, often hourly. Use Hex (or comparable SQL-notebook tool), Amplitude, Looker Studio, and Almedia's internal Freecash AI every working day.

- Develop a proactive account instinct. You'll work toward spotting issues before they become problems, push budget increases, geo expansions, and format tests on a rhythm. You'll learn to intervene before a metric becomes a complaint.

- Bridge commercial and technical teams. When partners flag issues, you'll debug, coordinate with engineering, and communicate back clearly to the partner.

- Contribute to the playbook. Help document process improvements as you learn. Your fresh perspective is an asset.

WHAT YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS LOOK LIKE

- Days 1-30: Shadow our Senior Growth Managers on their account calls. Take over 2 small accounts (sub-€10K daily spend) and learn the backbone of our growth engine hands-on.

- Days 31-60: Take over a full book of 5-10 accounts. Own your first KPI review with our a senior team member. Contribute with your first written process improvement.

- Days 61-90: Operating with increasing independence. You've caught at least one issue before it escalated and proposed a test or lever on your book.

- Beyond 90 days: A clear path from Growth Manager to Senior Growth Manager to Strategic Growth Lead and beyond.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING 💡

- You're hungry and looking for a challenge. You want to build and own real outcomes, not collect a title. You have some professional experience, have had to figure things out independently and you liked it.

- You tell stories with data. You read the numbers, then you tell their story. You don't need to be a data scientist, but you should be able to open a dashboard, spot something off, and ask the right questions.

- You're bilingual in the best sense, equally fluent and comfortable talking commercial with advertisers and technical with algorithm teams in the same day.

- You speak Turkish on a native level, have ideally worked in this market before and understand the market specifics.

- Have some exposure to performance marketing metrics like ROAS, LTV, retention, or ARPU. If not, we'll get you there by week 2.

title: Timekeeping Systems Manager
description:
About Legence Legence (Nasdaq: LGN) is a leading provider of engineering, consulting, installation, and maintenance services for mission-critical systems in buildings. The company specializes in designing, fabricating, and installing complex HVAC, process piping, and other mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems-enhancing energy efficiency, reliability, and sustainability in new and existing facilities. Legence also delivers long-term performance through strategic upgrades and holistic solutions. Serving some of the world’s most technically demanding sectors, Legence counts over 60% of the Nasdaq-100 Index among its clients.
Job Title Timekeeping Systems & Compliance Manager
Position Overview The Timekeeping Systems Manager serves as the business owner and enterprise subject matter expert for Legence ’s timekeeping systems, processes, and governance framework. This role is responsible for developing, implementing, and optimizing scalable timekeeping solutions that support operational requirements, workforce compliance obligations, and accurate payroll processing across the organization.
As Legence evolves its workforce management capabilities, this position will lead timekeeping system strategy, business requirements, implementation initiatives, and ongoing enhancement while partnering closely with Payroll, HRIS, Human Resources, Operations, Finance, IT and business leaders. The role ensures timekeeping practices, controls, and systems support operational efficiency, compliance, audit readiness, and a consistent employee experience.
Key Responsibilities Timekeeping Systems Management & Compliance

• Serve as the business owner for enterprise timekeeping systems and workforce management technologies.

• Partner closely with Payroll to ensure accurate time capture, payroll processing, compliance, and seamless integration between timekeeping and payroll systems.

• Lead the design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization of timekeeping solutions.

• Define business requirements, system configurations, workflows, approval structures, and reporting requirements.

• Ensure timekeeping systems support varying business models, labor agreements, regulatory requirements, and operational needs.

• Establish and maintain enterprise controls, audit standards, and monitoring processes to ensure data integrity, compliance, and audit readiness.

• Ensure compliance with federal, state, local, and industry-specific labor regulations, including wage and hour requirements and SOX-related controls impacting timekeeping and payroll processes.

• Evaluate technology solutions and provide recommendations regarding build-versus-buy decisions for timekeeping and workforce management capabilities.

• Partner with HRIS, IT, Payroll, and third-party vendors to implement enhancements, resolve complex issues, and support long-term system strategy.

Enterprise Projects & Process Improvement

• Lead enterprise-wide timekeeping initiatives, system implementations, upgrades, and process improvement efforts.

• Facilitate requirements gathering, stakeholder alignment, testing strategies, and implementation planning.

• Coordinate cross-functional teams to deliver projects on time and within scope.

• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, user experience, compliance, and operational effectiveness.

• Develop and maintain key performance indicators, audit metrics, and operational reporting.

• Investigate complex timekeeping issues, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions.

Training & Stakeholder Support

• Develop and deliver training related to timekeeping systems, policies, and processes.

• Create and maintain system documentation, procedures, job aids, and support materials.

• Communicate process changes, system enhancements, and regulatory requirements to stakeholders.

• Serve as the escalation point for complex timekeeping system and compliance issues.

• Provide guidance to leaders

title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
description:
Description
A Career at Clarius
Today, as many as 25 million medical professionals globally don’t have access to medical imaging, which is proven to improve patient care and reduce healthcare costs. That’s why we’re on a mission to make medical imaging accessible everywhere by delivering high-performance, affordable, and easy-to-use solutions powered by artificial intelligence and connected to the cloud.
By making Clarius your next career move, you’re joining a team of 140+ people who are talented, innovative, and highly collaborative. You’re also joining a community that includes thousands of physicians worldwide who use Clarius to deliver better patient care! And you’re joining a thrice-certified Great Place to Work!
Your Role
Clarius is looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to build and lead the programs that turn marketing interest into sales-ready demand and keep customers engaged after purchase.
You will own our lifecycle marketing engine across nurture, email, content, database re-engagement, customer marketing, integrated campaigns, and emerging channels such as SMS.
This is a highly hands-on role for a strategic marketer who is also an exceptional writer . You’ll develop campaign strategy, write compelling email and blog content, lead the email experience, and create connected journeys across the customer lifecycle.
You’ll work closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, Growth Marketing, Clinical Marketing, Customer Experience, and Creative to drive engagement, MQLs, product adoption, pipeline, and revenue.
Your Responsibilities Include:
Own the Lifecycle & Nurture Engine

• Own and continuously optimize Clarius’ pre-sale nurture strategy and programs.

• Build journeys based on specialty, customer profile, intent, behavior, geography, and buying stage.

• Develop triggered, re-engagement, and database activation campaigns that move prospects toward sales readiness.

• Identify where prospects are stalling and use Sales and customer insights to improve conversion and funnel progression.

Lead Email & Lifecycle Communications

• Own the annual, quarterly, and monthly email calendar , aligning communications across content, product launches, webinars, events, promotions, clinical education, and other marketing priorities.

• Lead campaigns end-to-end, including audience, brief, messaging, copy, creative direction, launch, measurement, and optimization.

• Build scalable email processes and reusable campaign formats that improve speed and quality.

• Evaluate where emerging lifecycle channels, including SMS, can add value for high-intent or time-sensitive communications.

• Partner with Marketing Operations on technical builds, segmentation, testing, deliverability, consent, and compliance.

Build Integrated Campaigns & ABM Programs

• Develop integrated campaigns across email, content, webinars, events, product launches, Sales outreach, paid media, and other marketing channels.

• Lead the campaign orchestration component of Account-Based Marketing, creating coordinated journeys and touchpoints for priority accounts and segments.

• Partner across Sales, Growth Marketing, Marketing Operations, and Product Marketing to align audiences, messaging, activation, and follow-up.

• Build event and webinar acquisition and follow-up programs that turn engagement into continued marketing or Sales action.

Own Content & Blog Strategy

• Own the content and editorial calendar , ensuring it supports lifecycle, campaign, product launch, event, SEO, and business priorities.

• Write Clarius blog content and integrate it into broader campaigns and customer journeys.

• Develop and repurpose content across email, nurture, webinars, events, social, and Sales follow-up.

• Translate complex clinical and technical information into simple, compelling customer-focused messaging.

• Partner with Creative to lead the design and customer experience of emails and campaign assets.

Support the Post-Purchase Customer Journey

title: Partnerships Lead
description:
About BJAK
BJAK was founded on a simple belief: people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. That is where our name comes from.

We started in 2019 by building the region's first mobile-first insurance platform, making insurance accessible online to millions. Today we are Southeast Asia's leading insurance platform, and we are expanding into everything else people do with their money - spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling.

Our teams span more than 20 nationalities across our offices and remotely. We look for people who work for the thing itself rather than the hours, who want to build the next generation of products rather than maintain the current one, and who care about getting great financial tools into everyone's hands rather than a select few.

If that sounds like you, we would like to talk.

The role
You will be BJAK's person on the ground, responsible for getting the business established and growing. That means building partner relationships from scratch, working out how the market operates, and shaping the strategy that sits behind both.

This is a broad role in a new market. Some weeks will be partnership negotiation, others will be regulatory groundwork, operational setup, or working out why something is not converting. We are looking for someone comfortable moving between all of it rather than a specialist in any one part.
What you will do
Partnerships

• Identify, approach and close partnerships with financial institutions and ecosystem players

• Own each relationship end to end, from first conversation through negotiation, onboarding, integration and go-live

• Lead commercial negotiations, with sound judgement on pricing and partnership economics

• Keep a visible pipeline, with disciplined follow-up and clear reporting

• Work with legal, product, technology and compliance to get agreements live quickly

Get the market working

• Establish how we operate locally, including the regulatory requirements that apply to us

• Work with external counsel and internal compliance on the policies we need in place as we grow

• Act as a primary point of contact for regulators and manage filings and communications

• Own monthly revenue, volume and activation targets, and drive partner productivity after go-live

Strategy and operations

• Set the local strategy - which segments we go after, which partners matter most, where we compete and where we do not

• Build the operating rhythm behind it, from reporting and planning through to the processes the team runs on

• Feed what you learn locally into our wider regional and global strategy, and bring the global playbook back into the local market

• Work with teams across the group, taking what has already worked elsewhere rather than rebuilding from scratch

What we are looking for

• Fluent Indonesian and English, written and spoken

• At least five years across technology, financial services or a comparable commercial environment, with real negotiation and partnership experience

• A generalist who has operated across functions - you have done commercial work, but also picked up operations, regulatory, product or whatever else the situation needed

• Comfortable moving between strategy and execution, and willing to do both in the same week

• Evidence of building something from nothing, whether a market, a function or a business line

• Comfortable with ambiguity and self-directed. We expect initiative rather than instruction, and this role will not suit someone who needs to be nudged or handheld

Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

- Embed yourself deeply inside strategic customers: act as a trusted partner with a provisioned account, spend meaningful time onsite, and own delivery outcomes as if you were part of their team.

W  T&P  łączymy kreatywność, technologię i media, by dostarczać naszym Klientom kompleksowe rozwiązania komunikacyjne. Nasza przedsiębiorcza struktura działa w 45 biurach na czterech kontynentach.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission!

💡 YOUR MISSION

As a Care Expert, you are the trusted care advisor for voize's most important care group customers. Together with their Customer Success Manager, you make sure voize really changes how care teams work - not just that it goes live. You speak with QM-Leitungen and Pflegedienstleitungen as a peer, because you have done their job. Your success shows in adoption and in the time teams get back.

🚀 YOUR DAILY BUSINESS

- Support 6-10 strategic care group accounts as their care expert, side by side with their Customer Success Manager

- Look at QM processes, documentation routines and the EHR setup (e.g. Vivendi) before go-live, so mismatches surface early instead of during rollout

- Talk with QM-Leitungen and Pflegedienstleitungen as a peer about process design, how documentation is structured, and change management - in their language, not ours

- Review adoption with customer leadership after go-live and share clear, practical recommendations on voize settings and on care workflows

- Bring what you see across accounts back to our Product team, and name clearly what is a process topic, an EHR setup topic, or a real product need

🤝 YOUR SKILLSET

- You have worked as Pflegedienstleitung, QM-Beauftragte/r or in a similar senior care quality or operations role - at the level of the people you will advise

- You know QM processes, care documentation standards and EHR systems (ideally Vivendi/Snap) in stationärer Altenpflege

- You speak fluent German and can meet a careful Pflegedienstleitung, a cautious Geschäftsführung and a busy IT admin on the same day, each in their own way

- You think in a structured way and can tell whether something is a process topic, a system setup topic, or a change management topic - and what helps in each case

- You enjoy close collaboration: with CSMs, with Product, and on building the Care Expert playbook together

🌱 GROWING TOGETHER - WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT AT VOIZE

- We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle new topics, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving healthcare professionals more time for real patient care

- We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events, whether you work from our Berlin office or remotely from Germany

title: Software Engineer, RL Data
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SOFTWARE ENGINEER, RL DATA

ABOUT THE ROLE

The data behind a model shapes it more than almost anything else. On the RL Data team at SpaceXAI, you decide what that data is for our agents: which problems they practice, what world they practice in, and how they're judged. You'll take a weakness, like an agent that gives up on hard bugs or misuses a calendar API, and turn it into training data that fixes it, then show the next model is measurably better.

You form hypotheses about why data is helping or misleading the model, build the systems to test them, run ablations, and read the rollouts to find the bug, shortcut or mismatch behind a result. Every flaw you catch, or miss, shows up in what the next Grok models learn.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

- Turning a capability gap into thousands of verifiable tasks - for example, planting subtle bugs deep in a real project's dependencies for the agent to root-cause.

- Building environments that behave like production: real codebases with their real dependencies, and simulations of apps like email, calendar, and docs that match the real ones down to search, errors, and pagination.

- Designing graders for open-ended work that separate good solutions from bad without penalizing valid alternatives or rewarding shortcuts.

- Building automated checks that catch reward hacking, leaked answers, broken environments, and paths the real product wouldn't allow, before data reaches training.

- Scaling from a thousand hand-checked tasks to millions, with filters and judges you can trust in place of a person reading each one

YOU MAY BE A FIT IF

- You have strong software engineering fundamentals, and you've built non-trivial systems in Python: data pipelines, test or eval infrastructure, sandboxes, or backend services.

- You have taste for what makes an environment trustworthy: faithful enough that skills transfer, strict enough that shortcuts fail, and simple enough to debug when a result looks wrong.

- You are careful and systematic - understanding both aggregate metrics and close reading of raw outputs.

- You enjoy turning messy, open-ended problems into repeatable, high-quality data production systems.

- RL or ML experience is a plus but not required. We welcome strong engineers who want to do research on what makes models better.

APPLYING

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2-3 short technicals. After, we'll schedule an onsite in our office, where you'll work on a small project, discuss ideas, and meet the team.

title: Power Systems Studies Engineer - Dynamic Modeling
description:

Ulteig is currently seeking talented and motivated Studies level engineering candidates to support power system studies and transmission planning projects within the renewable energy and power markets
What You'll Do
The Studies Engineer for the dynamic studies team is expected to perform the following tasks:

• Develop PSSE, PSLF, TSAT, and PSCAD models of renewable plants

• Understand dynamic model block diagrams and tune parameters to meet regional model performance requirements
